fluff.overview: The Wusun is a medium-class OmniFighter built by United Outworlders Corporation on Ramora, introduced in 3084 as one of the few Clan-technology aerospace designs produced by an Inner Sphere manufacturer. A joint venture between UOC and Clan Snow Raven, the fighter emerged from a decade of deepening industrial cooperation between the two powers. The project came to fruition through the persistent diplomacy of Outworlds Alliance President Camden Avellar, who convinced the Ravens that UOC was both capable and trustworthy enough to handle full Clan technology. Configured primarily as a close-range interceptor, the Wusun reflects Snow Raven's preference for aggressive engagement, leveraging its heavy armor and high thrust to dictate the terms of any dogfight. Its name was chosen deliberately to signal that despite Alliance financing and labor, this was a Snow Raven machine.
fluff.capabilities:
The Wusun's 330-rated XL fusion engine delivers a safe thrust of 8 and maximum thrust of 12, giving it exceptional closing speed against both conventional fighters and other OmniFighters of comparable size. Carrying 11.5 tons of Raven Ferro-Aluminum Comp B armor distributed across its nose, wings, and aft sections, the design is unusually durable for a medium-class craft, able to weather enemy fire during the closing phase of an engagement without sacrificing maneuverability. The frame carries 24 tons of pod space, providing considerable flexibility across its five configurations. All variants share the Outworlds Advanced 6ai communications suite and the Multi-platform T12d targeting and tracking system.

The Prime configuration combines three ER medium lasers with four Streak SRM-6 launchers and a targeting computer, built for decisive close-in combat. The A configuration takes a longer engagement profile, pairing nose-mounted medium pulse lasers with Artemis IV-guided LRM-15 racks in each wing. The B configuration concentrates firepower into a single nose-mounted HAG 40, a specialized loadout that sacrifices flexibility for devastating burst damage. The C configuration takes an all-energy approach, grouping an ER large laser with three heavy medium lasers per wing pod, backed by a generous allocation of additional heat sinks. The D configuration, developed in 3121, adds a Gauss rifle, an Improved Heavy Large Laser, and an ECM suite, adapting the chassis for operations in electronically contested environments. Across all configurations, the design's primary trade-off is evident: close-range specialization in exchange for unmatched thrust and protection.
fluff.deployment: The C configuration's all-energy loadout makes it appealing for extended operations where ammunition resupply is unavailable, particularly in deep-space interdiction or prolonged campaign operations away from established logistics chains. The heavy medium laser clusters deliver considerable concentrated damage at close range, with the targeting computer helping offset their inherent accuracy limitations. This variant is favored for long-duration patrol and raiding missions where independence from supply lines is a tactical advantage.
fluff.history:
The Wusun's origins trace back to the 3060s, when United Outworlders Corporation began a long apprenticeship under Clan Snow Raven technicians, producing first the Corax OmniFighter and then advanced Hellcat and Lightning variants. By the mid-3070s, UOC president Camden Avellar believed the corporation was ready to attempt a fighter built entirely from Clan technology, and laid a detailed business proposal before the Snow Raven Merchant Factor. The proposal cited the successful integration of Clan merchants with private industry, the strong popular support for Snow Raven among the Ramoran population, and the efficiency advantages a surface-based production facility would offer over the Clan's mobile factory assets.

The Raven Council hesitated. Allowing full Clan technology access to an Inner Sphere partner was a significant concession, and no decision was reached for over a year. Economics ultimately proved decisive. Clan Snow Raven needed to rebuild its aerospace manufacturing capacity, and UOC offered the resources to make it happen. Negotiations resumed and construction of the new Clantech production line began in 3076. The Word of Blake's Jihad-era attacks on Ramora complicated matters considerably, as Inferno terrorist strikes destroyed worker habitats and damaged existing production infrastructure, and a Screaming Eagles mercenary assault misdirected by Word manipulation added to the disruption. Despite these setbacks, construction continued and the first Wusun fighters entered service in 3084.

The design launched under strict commercial controls: Clan Snow Raven was both the sole authorized buyer and the exclusive supplier of key components, and all facility staff were subject to mandatory background checks. The arrangement suited both parties. The Raven Alliance acquired a capable new OmniFighter produced near its Inner Sphere territories, while UOC secured its long-term position as a Clantech production partner, anticipating access to component markets and future contracts. Distribution remained tight through the Early Republic era, with small numbers allocated to elite Outworlds Alliance pilots alongside the primary Snow Raven recipients. Interest from other Clans was noted in the design's early years, though no Trials were declared. The D variant, developed in 3121, demonstrated the airframe's continued relevance as conditions shifted under the Republic.
